oids.name: webPort

oids.name: macAddress
oids.description: Hardware network address

oids.name: enablePing
oids.description: Enables ping watchdog feature. If enabled, the IP address for each outlet (if non-zero) will be pinged periodically; the outlet will be rebooted if there is no ping response.

oids.name: pingInterval
oids.description: Interval (in minutes) beween attempts to ping the IP address corresponding to an outlet.

oids.name: mailServerIPAddress

oids.description: Email address (x@y.z format) to be used as the from address for logs and alerts.

oids.name: sendAlertsToUser1Address

oids.name: sendAlertsToUser2Address

oids.name: sendLogFrequency

oids.description: Time of day to send logs via email. Not applicable if sendLogFrequency is set to whenFull or never.

oids.name: userLogInLogOutFailed

oids.name: outletActivity

oids.name: systemOnOff
